faq.q: What kinds of homes sit under $1.8M in South Surrey?
faq.a: The live page frames the band as townhomes, half duplexes, rowhomes and some detached houses, mostly in Grandview Heights, around Semiahmoo Town Centre and along King George Boulevard, and its visible cards were a Grandview townhouse and detached houses in Grandview and King George Corridor.

faq.q: My listing shows an old zone name like RF or RF-SD. What does it mean now?
faq.a: Surrey's SSMUH framework replaced RF with R3 Urban Residential and RF-SD with R6 Semi-Detached, and removed the RM-D duplex zone; the City directs owners to the current zoning bylaw and its mapping for the parcel's present zone.
